items.name: spec_compliance
items.note: Implements exactly the user's confirmed scope: regex-detected file mentions + evidencePath become clickable links inside TriageDetailModal only (Compliance detail view explicitly out of scope per user answer), opening a side-by-side panel (not an overlapping modal) reusing SmartViewer.

items.name: error_handling
items.note: No new API routes or server code; the reused SmartViewer/file route already handles loading/error/too-large states, unchanged here.

items.name: security_basics
items.note: Mention text renders as React children (auto-escaped); the file path resolved from a mention is passed to the existing path-guarded (realpath+relative) file route unchanged — no new trust boundary introduced.

items.name: test_quality
items.note: extractFileMentions.test.ts (10 cases incl. negative cases: semver, commit SHA, ADR reference, empty string), FileMentionText.test.ts (3), TriageDetailModal.test.tsx new describe block (4: evidencePath link, in-text mention, close, no-mention plain text) — all assert on rendered outcome/callback args, not internals.

items.name: performance_basics
items.note: extractFileMentions is a single regex pass over a short triage message string; no loops of DB/network calls, no unbounded list rendering.

items.name: naming_structure
items.note: New files under client/src/lib and client/src/components/triage matching existing grouping. TriageDetailModal.tsx net REDUCED 371->333 lines via extraction into TriageDetailMeta.tsx (avoids ratcheting its grandfathered 375-line bloat-baseline entry).

items.name: affected_boundaries
items.note: Read-only feature: no new or changed serialized format (evidencePath/detail are existing TriageItem fields, unchanged shape; no new write path).

items.name: test_hygiene_probe
items.note: scan_test_hygiene.py --diff: no findings on the new/changed test files.
